items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: There's a beautiful thing, I forget which it is now, which has a duet between Carney and Otto Hardwick.

ctx.x: Or fire somebody. Although, as we all know, Duke never fired anybody, but make them quit, you know... There's some beautiful stuff... We just talked about records that got destroyed. But all those Treasury broadcasts that the Ellington band used to do in the Forties, they're all coming out on LP. There's a guy who is putting out 47 LPs, and it's up to thirty-something now. But on those, you'll hear the band play a lot of things that they never recorded commercially. Things like "Don't You Know I Care?" and...…
